tclLsp.serverPath.description: Path to a tcl-lsp checkout (workspace root). When set, the extension probes target/{release,debug}/ under it for a locally built tcl-lsp-server binary. If empty, uses the bundled native binary.

tclLsp.rustServerPath.description: Path to the native Rust tcl-lsp-server binary. If empty, uses the bundled binary, then probes target/{release,debug}/ under the workspace root.

tclLsp.dialect.description: Default dialect for files without a shebang or ``# tcl-dialect:`` comment directive. Per-file hints (shebang, comment directive, file extension) take priority over this setting.

tclLsp.extraCommands.description: Additional command names to treat as known commands (generic varargs signature).

tclLsp.bigipVersion.description: Target BIG-IP (TMOS) release for version-aware F5 diagnostics (for example 17.1.0). Empty uses the oldest supported release; the modelled data is declared against a 15.0 baseline.

tclLsp.libraryPaths.description: Additional directories to scan for Tcl packages and libraries. Paths may be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

tclLsp.notifications.highlightingHealth.description: Warn when semantic highlighting can't reach a Tcl file (wrong language association, or semantic highlighting disabled), which leaves grammar-only colouring that mis-highlights keywords inside braced string arguments. Each notice can also be dismissed permanently via its 'Don't show again' button.

tclLsp.suppressDiagnosticsInDiffEditors.description: Hide Tcl diagnostics (errors and warnings) for a file while it is shown only in a diff editor — a Git change in Source Control, 'Compare With…', or 'Compare with Saved'. Diagnostics in a diff are the underlying file's own full-file diagnostics (the analyser never runs on diff content), so they are shown by default; enable this to read changes without the analyser's noise. The file always keeps its diagnostics when it is also open in a normal editor. Purely a client-side display choice; the server keeps analysing. (Deliberately not under tclLsp.diagnostics.*, which is reserved for per-code on/off toggles.)

tclLsp.features.hover.description: Override hover information. When null, inherits from editor.hover.enabled.

tclLsp.features.diagnostics.description: Override diagnostics (errors and warnings). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.semanticTokens.description: Override semantic token highlighting. When null, inherits from editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled.

tclLsp.features.codeActions.description: Override code actions (quick fixes). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.documentSymbols.description: Override document symbols (outline view, breadcrumbs, Cmd+Shift+O). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.folding.description: Override code folding. When null, enabled (does not inherit editor.folding -- sticky scroll needs folding ranges even when the folding UI is off).

tclLsp.features.rename.description: Override rename symbol (F2). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.signatureHelp.description: Override signature help (parameter hints). When null, inherits from editor.parameterHints.enabled.

tclLsp.features.workspaceSymbols.description: Override workspace symbols (Cmd+T). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.inlayTypeHints.description: Show inferred-type inlay hints on variables (and format-string specifiers). Off by default; set true to enable.

tclLsp.features.inlayParameterHints.description: Show parameter-name inlay hints at proc/method call sites (e.g. NAME:, PROC_SCRIPT:). Verbose; off by default, set true to enable.

tclLsp.features.callHierarchy.description: Override call hierarchy (incoming/outgoing calls for procs). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.documentLinks.description: Override document links (clickable source paths and package requires). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.selectionRange.description: Override selection range (smart expand/shrink). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.documentHighlight.description: Override document highlight. When null, inherits from editor.occurrencesHighlight.

tclLsp.features.codeLens.description: Override code lens (inline reference counts, test runners). When null, inherits from editor.codeLens.

tclLsp.features.workspaceFileOps.description: Override workspace file operations (auto-rewrite source paths on rename). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.pullDiagnostics.description: Enable pull-model diagnostics (textDocument/diagnostic, workspace/diagnostic). Off by default: turning this on causes most clients to stop honouring push notifications.

tclLsp.features.willSaveWaitUntil.description: Format the document on save via textDocument/willSaveWaitUntil. Off by default; enable for format-on-save without relying on the editor's own editor.formatOnSave. Uses the resolved tclLsp.formatting.lineLength for the document's folder.

tclLsp.features.implementation.description: Override Go to Implementation (TclOO method overrides). When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.typeDefinition.description: Override Go to Type Definition. When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.declaration.description: Override Go to Declaration. When null, enabled.

tclLsp.features.linkedEditingRange.description: Override linked editing range. When null, inherits from editor.linkedEditing.

tclLsp.features.crossFileResolution.description: Resolve diagnostics across the whole workspace: suppress "unknown command" (W120/W123) for a proc defined in another file, and report wrong-argument-count errors (E002/E003) for cross-file calls. Off by default (scans every workspace file); set true to enable. Independent of XC Migration diagnostics below.

tclLsp.style.lineLength.markdownDescription: Maximum line length for the **W111** diagnostic. Lines exceeding this limit are flagged.

enumDescriptions: Flag every non-ASCII character (most restrictive). Default for iRules/iApps.
Flag Unicode confusables (homoglyphs per unicode.org/Public/security confusables.txt) plus copy-paste artifacts. Default for Tcl.
Allow intentional Unicode (letters, digits, symbols in any script); only flag confusables and control characters.
tclLsp.style.nonAscii.markdownDescription:
Controls how **W108** (non-ASCII character) is detected.

- **strict**: flag all non-ASCII characters (default for iRules/iApps).
- **confusables** *(default for Tcl)*: flag Unicode confusables (homoglyphs from the Unicode security spec) and copy-paste artifacts.
- **common**: allow Unicode letters, symbols, and punctuation; flag only confusables and control characters.
- **off**: disable W108.

enumDescriptions: Readability improvements only — idiomatic rewrites, no code removal.
Readability + constant folding and pattern recognition.
All optimisations with multi-pass to fixpoint.
tclLsp.optimiser.profile.markdownDescription: Optimisation profile controlling which passes run as diagnostics. Individual `O1xx` toggles below override the profile when explicitly set.

tclLsp.optimiser.O100.markdownDescription: **O100:** Propagate constant variables into expressions and command arguments. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O101.markdownDescription: **O101:** Fold constant integer expressions. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O102.markdownDescription: **O102:** Forward a variable's single reaching literal load to its use sites. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O103.markdownDescription: **O103:** Fold static procedure calls using interprocedural summaries. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O104.markdownDescription: **O104:** Fold static string build chains into a single assignment. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O105.markdownDescription: **O105:** Propagate constants into variable references and detect redundant computations (GVN/CSE). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O106.markdownDescription: **O106:** Hoist loop-invariant computations. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O107.markdownDescription: **O107:** Eliminate unreachable dead code. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O108.markdownDescription: **O108:** Eliminate transitively dead code. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O109.markdownDescription: **O109:** Eliminate dead stores. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O111.markdownDescription: **O111:** Brace expression performance hints (paired with W100). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O112.markdownDescription: **O112:** Eliminate constant-condition compound statements. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O114.markdownDescription: **O114:** Recognise `incr` idiom (`set x [expr {$x + N}]` → `incr x N`). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O115.markdownDescription: **O115:** Remove redundant nested `[expr {...}]` in expression context. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O116.markdownDescription: **O116:** Fold constant `[list a b c]` to literal value. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O117.markdownDescription: **O117:** Simplify `[string length $s] == 0` → `$s eq ""`. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O118.markdownDescription: **O118:** Fold constant `[lindex {a b c} 1]` to element. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O119.markdownDescription: **O119:** Pack consecutive `set` literals into `lassign`/`foreach`. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O120.markdownDescription: **O120:** Prefer `eq`/`ne` over `==`/`!=` for string comparisons. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O121.markdownDescription: **O121:** Rewrite self-recursive tail calls to `tailcall`. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O122.markdownDescription: **O122:** Convert fully tail-recursive proc to iterative `while` loop. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O123.markdownDescription: **O123:** Detect non-tail recursion eligible for accumulator introduction (hint only). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O124.markdownDescription: **O124:** Comment out unused procs in iRules (not called from any event). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O125.markdownDescription: **O125:** Sink side-effect-free assignments into the deepest decision block (`if`/`switch`) that uses them. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O126.markdownDescription: **O126:** Remove unused variable assignments — eliminate `set` statements for variables that are never read. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O127.markdownDescription: **O127:** Inline single-use variable assignment — eliminate redundant variable load by folding `set` into the use site. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O128.markdownDescription: **O128:** Rewrite `[expr {[llength $L] - N}]` / `[expr {[string length $s] - N}]` to `end-(N-1)` when used as an index argument. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O129.markdownDescription: **O129:** Fold a pure builtin command substitution with constant arguments (`[string length ...]`, `[join ...]`, `[format ...]`, `[dict get ...]`, …). (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.optimiser.O130.markdownDescription: **O130:** Fold static `lappend` list build chains into a single assignment. (`null` = inherit from profile)

tclLsp.runtimeValidation.enabled.description: Run runtime validation on save using dialect-aware adapters.

enumDescriptions: Automatically pick adapter by detected dialect (recommended).
Use Tcl syntax completeness checks only.
Use iRules-aware stubs and validate top-level when blocks.

tclLsp.runtimeValidation.tclshPath.description: Path to the tclsh executable used for runtime validation.

tclLsp.runtimeValidation.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for runtime validation commands.

tclLsp.ai.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable AI-powered chat participants (@irule and @tcl). When disabled, the chat participants will not respond to requests. Requires VS Code Copilot Chat.

text.description: Additional system prompt text to append.

dialects.description: Dialects this prompt applies to. Use "*" for all dialects.

tclLsp.ai.extraPrompts.markdownDescription:
Extra system prompt fragments appended to the built-in prompts. Each entry is scoped to a set of dialects (use `*` for all). Example:
```json
[{ "text": "Always suggest data-groups for allow/deny lists.", "dialects": ["f5-irules"] }]
```

tclLsp.packageManager.registryUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the Tcl package registry (`packages.json`). Used for `tcl pkg search` and dependency discovery.

tclLsp.packageManager.cacheDir.markdownDescription: Override the tclpkg cache directory. Empty uses the platform-native cache path (`~/.cache/tcl-lsp/tclpkg/` on Linux).

tclLsp.packageManager.autoInstallOnSave.markdownDescription: When `tclpkg.tcl` is saved, automatically run `tcl pkg install` to refresh the lockfile.

tclLsp.packageManager.offline.markdownDescription: Never touch the network — tclpkg always operates against the local cache.

tclLsp.xcDiagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) translatability diagnostics inline. Highlights which iRule constructs can be translated to XC-native routes, service policies, and header processing. Useful for migration planning.

tcl-lsp.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Tcl language server. Useful for diagnosing protocol-level issues.

testFile.description: Path to the iRule test file
